svg.text: Sparse-label EV battery surrogate: concentration + lumped temperature + analytically coupled particle stress
ĉₛ(ρ,τ) = cₛ,0* + τ Nᶜ(ρ,τ,C*,T*ₐₘᵦ) · hard initial condition
T̂*(τ) = T*ₐₘᵦ + τ Nᵀ(τ,C*,T*ₐₘᵦ) · hard initial condition
Automatic differentiation evaluates PDE and boundary residuals.
σ̂ᵣ, σ̂θ = S[ĉₛ ; E, ν, Ω]
backpropagation updates both subnetworks; the stress operator has no trainable parameters
Constant-current discharge surrogate · PyBaMM SPMe reference · linear-elastic stress indicator · no degradation, SOH, RUL, or experimental-validation claim
